units.intent: Unit tests for BedrockBlockingCommandQueue's per-identifier and per-command rate limiting: sliding-window accounting, partial credit at window edges, block-duration hold/clear, and log-prefix restoration around a blocked dequeue.

objects.name: TestBlockingCommandQueue
objects.role: subclasses BedrockBlockingCommandQueue with a test-controlled clock and a makeCommand() helper

objects.name: BlockingCommandQueueTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture with 13 tests over rate-limit dimensions, window expiry, block duration, and prefix scoping

units.intent: Integration test verifying a single chainedrequest command (via the clustertest test plugin) fans out to multiple external HTTP requests and reports each site's status.

objects.name: ChainedHTTPTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture loading the clustertest testplugin and verifying plausible status codes for each fanned-out site

units.intent: Verifies SuppressCommandPort/ClearCommandPort: closing the port records a reason in Status's commandPortBlockReasons, mismatched clears are no-ops, and matching clears reopen the port.

Integration tests for Bedrock's Query command: malformed/missing/unterminated queries, single- and multi-statement execution, the no-WHERE DELETE guard, and SQLite's percentile/median aggregate functions.

misfits.why: verifies SQLite's built-in SQLITE_ENABLE_PERCENTILE aggregate functions (median/percentile/percentile_cont/percentile_disc) rather than anything specific to Bedrock's own Query command handling - effectively a build-flag/compiled-in-extension check riding on this fixture

units.intent: Smoke tests for the Query command handling a plain read-only SELECT, with and without an HTTP method line, plus rejection of a malformed (missing-semicolon) query.

objects.name: ReadTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture running SELECT 1 through BedrockTester and checking the 502 rejection of a bad query

name_fit.note: Generic name for what is specifically a Query-command test; gives no hint it's about Query.

naming_quality.note: Consistent with sibling fixtures; only the top-level name is vague.

units.intent: Integration tests for outbound HTTPS: passthrough requests to real sites via a BedrockTester, and a proxied HTTPS transaction through SHTTPSProxySocket/SStandaloneHTTPSManager.

objects.name: SSLTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture; test() exercises passthrough sendrequest to a real and a fake host, proxyTest() drives an SStandaloneHTTPSManager::Transaction through a local proxy

units.intent: Smoke test confirming the Status command's response includes expected diagnostic fields (plugins, outstandingFramesToCheckpoint, freelistCount, pageCount).

objects.name: StatusTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture checking the Status response contains those field names

units.intent: Integration tests for Bedrock's Query/Write command path: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, the no-WHERE safety guard, parallel writes, HTTP-style and shorthand syntax, and blocking of non-deterministic SQL functions on write.

objects.name: WriteTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture (BedrockTester-backed) with 15 tests over write-command behavior

misfits.why: asserts on a known SQL-parsing limitation (an UPDATE without a WHERE-safety marker is not aborted in this specific case) that the test comment says is tracked in an external Expensify issue, rather than asserting intended behavior
